profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company traded as STX and headquartered in Singapore, according to its registration details. On its own website, Seagate describes itself as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. The company says it makes storage that scales and frames its work as bringing trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

The site's AI material is framed around data growth rather than a named product. Seagate says AI is accelerating data growth and reshaping storage requirements, and it invites organizations to evaluate their readiness and develop a storage strategy built for performance, scale, and growth. It also says people and machines will create in more ways and at a faster pace as AI proliferates, producing massive volumes of data, and that Seagate is optimizing storage for AI to support data center architecture and buildout. The site points readers to five strategic shifts it says can help close the gap between AI's growing data demands and infrastructure readiness.

No AI products, MCP servers, or lawsuits involving the company appear in the record.
